The next solar eclipse will be in:

```{r}
today <- Sys.Date()

next_eclipse_date <- mod_table |>
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) |>
  filter(Date >= today) |>
  slice_min(Date, n = 1) |>
  pull(Date)

next_eclipse_date
```
